## RestApplication.redirect() method

Register a route redirecting callers to a different URL.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redirect(fromPath: string, toPathOrUrl: string, statusCode?: number): Binding;
```

## Example


```ts
app.redirect('/explorer', '/explorer/');
```
